properties.label: Anthropic endpoint compatibility
properties.description: For expressions, secrets, or nonstandard proxy paths, verify the resolved URL uses the selected backend and its expected base path. Preserve intentional proxy prefixes and do not expose secret values. Mark Reviewed after configuring the endpoint and backend.

properties.label: OpenAI-compatible authentication
properties.description: An Authorization header overrides the legacy key. Move Bearer credentials to API key without the prefix and remove that header; keep other schemes as headers with None authentication. For dynamic keys, ensure API key mode always receives a non-empty key, or configure None for no-key calls. Mark Reviewed after configuring authentication; never paste secrets into the diagram.

properties.label: V2 deployment plan
properties.description: Ensure the v2 worker is available and configure its override only if customized. Deploy a new process version. Existing instances remain on v1; retain their worker/overrides while needed. Mark Reviewed when this rollout is planned, not as proof of deployment.

properties.label: V1 provider mapping
properties.description: The v1 provider is missing or unsupported by this migration. Select and configure the intended v2 provider.

validation.message: Select and configure the intended v2 provider, then mark V1 provider mapping Reviewed.
